# M11 The Treasure Train (escort): the four APCs apc1..apc4 start at the harbour (3,4)..(3,7) and must reach the relay camp rectangle (22,5)-(25,7) at the east end; the camp's city c (24,6) is neutral on the map and the mission gives it to the player. The road y6 crosses a forest (x7..11), the river x14 at ONE bridge (the ford, (14,6)) and a ruin (x15..19). Lash's HQ 2 (23,1) is the NE camp, Flak's HQ 3 (23,10) the SE camp. Threat/answer: marauder Tanks and Md Tanks at the ford -> own Md Tanks/Tanks and Artillery hit them from the west bank (the river keeps vehicles off), Missiles are not needed; Rockets and Artillery covering the ford and ruin (hold) -> Recon sees them, Tanks rush inside their minimum range, Artillery duels from the forest cover; Infantry and Mechs wade the river (foot units cross it) to flank the ford; Anti-Air only for the AA tank the player owns (no enemy aircraft on this map). Player start: APC4 RECON3 TANK3 MDT2 ART2 MECH2 INF2 AA1 (19 units), funds 3000, one base. Lash: INF3 TANK3 RECON2 ART1 MECH2 (11); Flak: MDT2 TANK2 INF3 ROCK1 (8). Marauders advance; Flak's Md Tanks (15,5),(15,7), Rockets (17,7) and Lash's Artillery (16,5) hold the ford.
